import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/dev')
import wire
from cmp import check
from run import run
v=wire.v
K=[{'keys':['A']}]
def NC(seq,rpt,cid,tok=b'\x22'*16): return bytes([0x18])+v(seq)+v(rpt)+bytes([len(cid)])+cid+tok
def A(body,pn=0,auth=0): return wire.datagram(wire.envelope('A',pn,body,cid=b'\xaa',width=1),auth=[auth])
frames=NC(3,3,b'\xe3')+NC(4,0,b'\xe4')+NC(5,0,b'\xe5')+NC(6,0,b'\xe6')
ev=[A(NC(1,0,b'\xd1')),A(NC(2,0,b'\xd2'),pn=1),A(frames,pn=2),A(NC(3,3,b'\xe3'),pn=3)]
t=wire.trace(K+ev, cids=3)
print(check({'traces':[t]}))
r=run({'traces':[t]})['traces'][0]
print([(p['pn'],p['status']) for p in r['packets']])
print('peers',r['peer_cids'],'rpt',r['retire_prior_to'],'closed',r['closed'])
"
